app.tagline: Write to your future self — then wait for the reply.

capsule.title: Capsules
capsule.desc: Sealed capsules stay hidden until their opening date, then open by themselves — you can also open one early by hand
capsule.empty: No capsules yet — seal one while creating a task
capsule.sealedText: This letter is still sealed in time. You can read it once the opening date arrives.
capsule.continueChat: Keep talking with your past self
capsule.errContent: Please write something to your future self
capsule.errFuture: The opening time has to be in the future
capsule.msgOpened: Capsule opened — go and read what your past self wrote
capsule.earlyConfirm: This capsule isn't due until {time}. Open it early anyway?

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.desc: Import things you have written — self-introductions, journals, notes. They will be distilled into "who you were".
knowledge.empty: Nothing imported yet. Use "Import a document" above to add something you have written.
knowledge.emptySearch: No documents match — try another word.
knowledge.batchDeleteConfirm: This deletes the {n} selected documents, and there is no undo in the app. Continue?
knowledge.contentPlaceholder: Paste in a self-introduction, journal entries, reading notes, a yearly review — the closer it is to the real you, the more the persona will sound like you.
knowledge.uploadTip: The file is read as text into the box below — or just paste it in.
knowledge.errTitle: Please give the document a title

persona.title: Persona
persona.desc: Turn the documents in your knowledge base into "who you were at a point in time" — a capsule holds the moment you wrote something, a persona holds who you were then
persona.empty: No personas yet. Import something you have written into the knowledge base first.
persona.deleteConfirm: Delete this persona? Your conversations with it will be deleted too.
persona.selfDatePlaceholder: Which point in time does this persona represent?
persona.selfDateTip: The same person is very different at different times — in temperament and in what they care about. So pick the date carefully.
persona.docsPlaceholder: Choose documents from your knowledge base
persona.docsTip: At least one. The closer they are to that point in time, the more the profile will sound like you then (your knowledge base has {n}).
persona.summaryPlaceholder: What kind of person were you then? What did you care about? What were you going through? Hand-written for now — once the model is connected you can generate it, and still edit it afterwards.
persona.stylePlaceholder: How did you talk then? Tone, favourite phrases, verbal tics. Also hand-written for now, generatable later.
persona.errName: Please give the persona a name
persona.errSelfDate: Please pick the point in time this persona represents
persona.errDocs: Please choose at least one document
persona.emptyKnowledge: Your knowledge base is still empty — import something you have written first
persona.materialsTip: "Document deleted" means the document this persona referenced has been removed from your knowledge base.

chat.title: Chat
chat.headCapsule: Talk with who you were when you wrote that capsule — they remember what you were working toward
chat.headPersona: Talk with who you were at a point in time — they remember what you wrote
chat.noPersona: No persona to talk to yet
chat.typingPersona: Who you were then is remembering…
chat.firstCapsule: This is your first conversation with your past self. Say something.
chat.firstPersona: This is your first conversation with "{name}". They remember what you wrote — ask them anything.
chat.clearConfirm: This conversation will be gone for good. Continue?
chat.notConfigured: AI is not configured yet, so you cannot chat
chat.notConfiguredHint: Chatting calls a language model with your own API key. Only this conversation is sent to the model — your tasks, capsules, knowledge base and personas always stay local.

demo.title: This is sample content
demo.desc: A few sample documents and a sample persona, so you can see what this looks like and what it does. Clear them and start recording your own.
demo.clearConfirm: This deletes the sample documents and the sample persona. Nothing you wrote yourself will be touched. Continue?
demo.cleared: Sample content cleared — go ahead and record your own

profile.title: Profile
profile.localNote: Stored in this browser — never uploaded to any server
profile.levelTip: One level per 5 finished tasks — {done}/5 so far
profile.noBadges: Finish more tasks to unlock your first badge
profile.avatarHint: JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF. Picking a file saves it right away — no extra button. The image is compressed on this device and stored in your browser; it is never uploaded anywhere.
profile.errAvatarType: Only JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF images are supported
profile.errAvatarSize: The image can't be larger than 20 MB

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: AI setup, storage, backup, and about
settings.offlineNote: Tasks, capsules, knowledge and personas work fully offline; only Chat goes online
settings.warnTitle: Your data only exists on this device
settings.warnDesc: Clearing browser data, using private browsing, or switching devices will make it disappear. Export a backup regularly.
settings.exportHint: Downloads a single JSON file containing your tasks, capsules, achievements, profile, knowledge documents, personas and conversations — but not your API key
settings.exportDone: Exported: {tasks} tasks, {capsules} capsules, {achievements} achievements, {knowledge} documents, {personas} personas, {dialogues} messages
settings.mergeHint: Adds entries that only exist in the backup; when both sides have the same entry, the newer one wins. Good for pulling in another device's data. Note that "newer" includes deletions — if the backup marks a record as deleted more recently, the local copy is deleted too.
settings.replaceHint: Wipes the current data and writes the backup in its place. Good for restoring on a new device, or going back to an older state.
settings.importHint: A snapshot of your current data is saved automatically first, so you can always roll back
settings.importConfirm: A replace import clears your current tasks, capsules, achievements, knowledge documents, personas and conversations before writing the backup. A snapshot is saved automatically first, so you can roll back. Continue?
settings.importDone: Import complete: {tasks} tasks, {capsules} capsules, {knowledge} documents, {personas} personas, {dialogues} messages. Open the tasks or capsules page to see the result.
settings.rollback: Roll back to before the last change
settings.rollbackNone: No snapshot to roll back to
settings.rollbackConfirm: This restores your data to the moment that snapshot was taken. Your current data is saved as a new snapshot first, so this step can itself be rolled back. Continue?
settings.rollbackDone: Rolled back: {tasks} tasks, {capsules} capsules, {knowledge} documents, {personas} personas, {dialogues} messages
settings.clearHint: Deletes every task, capsule, achievement, knowledge document, persona and conversation on this device. A snapshot is saved first, so you can roll back. Your AI setup is not affected — clear it in the AI setup card above.
settings.clearConfirm: This deletes every task, capsule, achievement, knowledge document, persona and conversation on this device. A snapshot is saved automatically first, so you can roll back afterwards. Your API key is left alone (clear it in the AI setup card). Continue?
settings.clearDone: Data erased — you can still roll back
settings.aiPrivacyDesc: The key is stored only in your own browser. On each message it travels with the request to the same-origin relay function we deploy, which forwards it to the provider. The server neither stores nor logs your key, and never logs the conversation. The key is not included in backups — you will need to enter it again on a new device.
settings.aiKeyHint: Create one in the provider's console. For safety it is never filled back into this field after saving; leaving it empty keeps the saved key.
settings.aiModelPlaceholder: Click "Test connection" to fetch the available models, or type one in
settings.aiModelHint: Clicking "Test connection" fetches the models this key can actually use, which is easier than typing a name from memory
settings.aiStatusOff: Not configured yet — Chat will not work
settings.aiTestOk: Connected — this key can use {n} models
settings.aiClearConfirm: The key will be removed from this device and Chat will stop working until you enter a new one. Continue?
settings.aboutArchValue: Local-first · no account · only Chat goes online
settings.languageHint: Takes effect immediately, and your choice is remembered on this device

landing.eyebrow: Local-first · no sign-up · your data stays yours
landing.heroSub: Seal a decision you're making today into a time capsule and set a date for it to open. Until then, keep the promise one task at a time.
landing.heroNote: Opens right away. Tasks, capsules, knowledge and personas all stay in your own browser and are never uploaded.
landing.featuresSub: Resolve, follow through, look back — the capsule ties all three together.
landing.featureCapsuleDesc: Write what you want to tell your future self and pick an opening date. When the date arrives it opens by itself — not a reminder to go click something, but the letter actually appearing.
landing.featureTaskDesc: Break the resolve into tasks you can actually finish. Your streak and level are computed from your completion history; there is nothing to maintain by hand.
landing.featureAchievementDesc: Finish 1, 3, 5, 10… tasks, open your 1st, 2nd, 3rd capsule, keep a 7-day streak — every milestone leaves a badge behind.
landing.dataSub: No account, no analytics. Everything lives in this device's browser and keeps working offline — with one exception: when you talk with who you were, that conversation goes to the model provider you configured yourself.
landing.dataPoint1: Tasks, capsules, knowledge and personas live in the browser's IndexedDB — never sent over the network
landing.dataPoint2: Export everything to a single JSON file whenever you like
landing.dataPoint3: Restore it fully by importing that file on another device
landing.dataPoint4: Open source and auditable — there is no reporting code anywhere
landing.dataPoint5: Chat is the only online feature: your own API key, and the conversation goes straight to the provider you choose
landing.dataNote: Your data lives only on this device. Clearing browser data, using private browsing, or switching devices will make it disappear — so remember to export a backup now and then.
landing.ctaTitle: Write to yourself three months from now
landing.footerDesc: A local-first time capsule and habit journal
